The hospital capacity risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a mean reward of 1.000 across all trials with zero exceptions recorded in the harbor job info. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.31 seconds using version 8.4.1. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor if scaling to cloud-based runtimes.
